definitions.gloss: office work, clerical duties, administrative work
definitions.explanation: Routine work in an office setting, such as paperwork, data entry, correspondence, and other administrative tasks.

examples.japanese: {事務|じむ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm in charge of office work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}した→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧。
examples.english: I organized documents at the office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧や{電話対応|でんわたいおう}⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧さまざまな{事務|じむ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなしている→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
examples.english: Every day I handle various administrative tasks such as accounting and answering phone calls.

notes:
{事務|じむ} refers to routine administrative and clerical work — paperwork, scheduling, correspondence, data management, and similar office tasks. It emphasizes the procedural, behind-the-scenes side of work rather than creative or decision-making roles.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧: office (workplace)
- ⟦{事務員|じむいん}→事務員：25266_jimuin⟧: office worker, clerk
- ⟦{事務局|じむきょく}→事務局：17056_jimukyoku⟧: secretariat, administrative office
- {事務|じむ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: clerical work
- {事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}: office supplies
- {事務|じむ}{手続|てつづ}き: administrative procedures

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {事務|じむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to handle administrative work
- {事務|じむ}{的|てき}な: administrative, clerical (adjective)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{事務|じむ} focuses on routine office tasks. ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧ is broader and covers all professional duties, including non-clerical work.
